summary: Phase 3 background generation and reliability integration validated at JVM level and on emulator-5554. All 24 Kotlin JVM tests across 5 test classes pass; four device tests pass for session deletion isolation, startup recovery, actual Completed/Failed notification delivery with safe copy, and the deterministic failed-outcome → safe Generation ErrorLog → Diagnostics Route → clipboard loop. The app-layer BackgroundGenerationOutcomeHandler is used by BackgroundGenerationWorker and injects no external Provider/network behavior into the device test. Debug APK builds successfully, lint passes, and the full Python suite passes (510 passed, 28 skipped). No frozen-layer changes were made.
